keywords.def: dishonest or illegal behaviour involving the abuse of power for personal gain
using authority or influence in an unfair or improper way
giving or receiving something valuable to influence someone’s actions
illegally taking money or property that you have been trusted to manage
giving jobs or advantages to family members because of their relationship
openness about decisions, actions, and the use of money or information
responsibility for your actions and their consequences

sentences.en: What is corruption?
sentences.zh: 什么是腐败？

sentences.en: Corruption or corrupt are words that I use quite often in my episodes… but what is corruption?
sentences.zh: 腐败或腐败分子这些词我在节目里经常用到……但究竟什么是腐败？

sentences.en: What forms does it take? Why does corruption happen, what damage does it cause, and why can it be so difficult to stop?
sentences.zh: 它有哪些形式？为什么会发生腐败，它会造成什么破坏，又为什么那么难以遏制？

sentences.en: In this episode, we are going to look at different types of corruption, the political and economic conditions that allow it to develop, and some of the consequences for ordinary people and society.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将探讨不同类型的腐败、孕育腐败滋生的政治与经济条件，以及它对普通人和社会带来的一些后果。

sentences.en: We’ll also look at three famous corruption scandals: the 1MDB scandal in Malaysia, the Siemens bribery scandal, and the huge corruption scandal that shook FIFA in 2015.
sentences.zh: 我们还将回顾三个著名的腐败丑闻：马来西亚的1MDB丑闻、西门子行贿丑闻，以及在2015年震撼国际足联的大型腐败丑闻。

sentences.en: So, let’s understand corruption while improving our English listening comprehension and learning some new vocabulary!
sentences.zh: 那么，就让我们在提升英语听力理解能力、学习一些新词汇的同时，来理解什么是腐败吧！

sentences.en: What exactly is corruption? The word corruption is a relatively broad term.
sentences.zh: 到底什么是腐败？“腐败”这个词是一个相对广泛的概念。

sentences.en: I think many of you listening might be aware of corruption and have attached your own meanings or your own images to the term.
sentences.zh: 我想听节目的各位很多可能对腐败有所耳闻，并在这个词上附加了你们自己的理解或形象。

sentences.en: You might immediately connect corruption to a politician taking a bribe or a government official stealing money.
sentences.zh: 你们可能会立刻把腐败和政客收受贿赂或政府官员偷钱联系起来。

sentences.en: Those are certainly examples of corruption.
sentences.zh: 这些当然都是腐败的例子。

sentences.en: A traditional definition of corruption is the abuse of public office for personal gain.
sentences.zh: 对腐败的一个传统定义是：滥用公权力以谋取私利。

sentences.en: Someone is given a position of responsibility, like being a politician or a judge.
sentences.zh: 某人被赋予了一定的职责，比如担任政客或法官。

sentences.en: They then use this position to benefit themselves.
sentences.zh: 然后他们利用这个职位来让自己受益。

sentences.en: Instead of using their power to serve the public, they benefit themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们没有利用权力为公众服务，而是让自己获利。

sentences.en: This is the basic, traditional definition of corruption.
sentences.zh: 这是对腐败最基础、最传统的定义。

sentences.en: But modern definitions tend to be broader.
sentences.zh: 但现代的定义往往更加广泛。

sentences.en: Corruption can be understood, in general, as the abuse of power or influence for improper gain.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，腐败可以被理解为：为不正当利益而滥用权力或影响力。

sentences.en: It doesn’t necessarily need to involve a government official or someone in public office.
sentences.zh: 它不一定非要涉及政府官员或公职人员。

sentences.en: It could be in a private company. And it doesn’t necessarily need to involve money either, just any kind of gain.
sentences.zh: 它可能发生在私营公司里。而且它也不一定非得涉及金钱，任何形式的利益都算。

sentences.en: A business executive might use their position to help a friend get a contract. or a politician might give government jobs to members of their family.
sentences.zh: 企业高管可能会利用自己的职位帮朋友拿到合同，或者政客可能会把政府职位分给自己的家庭成员。

sentences.en: An organization might manipulate a political process to protect its own interests.
sentences.zh: 一个组织可能会操纵政治程序来保护自身的利益。

sentences.en: These are all forms of corruption. Corruption can involve politicians, government officials, businesses, international organizations, basically anyone with power and influence.
sentences.zh: 这些都是腐败的形式。腐败可以涉及政客、政府官员、企业、国际组织，基本上涵盖了所有拥有权力和影响力的人。

sentences.en: It’s also useful to think about corruption at different levels.
sentences.zh: 从不同的层级来思考腐败也是很有用的。

sentences.en: Individual corruption happens when one person abuses their position, when one person is corrupt.
sentences.zh: 个体腐败发生在一个个人滥用其职位、一个人出现腐败行为的时候。

sentences.en: Institutional corruption happens when corrupt behavior becomes common within an organization.
sentences.zh: 体制腐败发生在腐败行为在一个组织内部变得司空见惯的时候。

sentences.en: And systemic corruption occurs when corruption becomes deeply embedded in the way an entire political or economic system operates.
sentences.zh: 而系统性腐败则发生在腐败深深嵌入整个政治或经济系统的运作方式之中时。

sentences.en: That might be a bit confusing, but think about it this way.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能有点让人困惑，但我们可以这样想。

sentences.en: One employee at a bank accepting bribes in return for giving out mortgages, that is individual corruption.
sentences.zh: 银行的一名员工在发放抵押贷款时接受贿赂，这就是个体腐败。

sentences.en: One employee is corrupt. If the entire bank was doing this regularly, accepting bribes and then giving out money, that would be institutional corruption.
sentences.zh: 有一个员工腐败了。如果整家银行都经常这么做，收受贿赂然后放贷，那就是体制腐败。

sentences.en: If all of the banks in a country were doing the same thing, that is systemic corruption.
sentences.zh: 如果一个国家的所有银行都在做同样的事情，那就是系统性腐败。

sentences.en: Now that we have, a general definition of corruption, let’s look at some of the different forms of corruption.
sentences.zh: 既然我们已经对腐败有了个概括性的定义，接下来让我们看看腐败的一些不同形式。

sentences.en: Perhaps the most famous type, a type I’ve mentioned a few times already, is bribery: to bribe someone, or to receive a bribe, to take a bribe.
sentences.zh: 也许最著名的类型——也是我已经提到过好几次的一种类型——就是行贿：贿赂某人，或是接受贿赂、拿回扣。

sentences.en: This is when someone offers, gives, receives, or asks for something valuable in order to influence a decision.
sentences.zh: 这是指某人提供、给予、接受或索取有价值的东西，以此来影响一项决定。

sentences.en: For example, a business will sometimes pay a government official secretly to win a contract.
sentences.zh: 例如，企业有时会私下向政府官员付钱以赢得合同。

sentences.en: The company might pay the government official $50,000.
sentences.zh: 这家公司可能会付给政府官员五万美元。

sentences.en: That government official can put that money in his own personal bank account.
sentences.zh: 那位政府官员可以把钱存进他个人的银行账户里。

sentences.en: He then awards the business the contract to build a bridge or a road.
sentences.zh: 然后他就会把建造桥梁或道路的合同判给这家企业。

sentences.en: The government then pays the business millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 接着政府会支付给这家企业数百万美元。

sentences.en: That is an example of bribery. You pay someone to influence a decision that’s even more valuable than the money you’re paying.
sentences.zh: 这就是行贿的一个例子。你付钱给别人，是为了换取一个价值远超你所付金钱的决策。

sentences.en: Bribery is only one type of corruption, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，行贿只是腐败的一种类型。

sentences.en: Another example is embezzlement. This happens when someone takes money or property that they have been trusted to manage.
sentences.zh: 另一个例子是挪用公款。当某人拿走了托付由其管理的金钱或财产时，这就发生了。

sentences.en: I will give an example of embezzlement later in the episode with the 1MDB scandal.
sentences.zh: 我会在节目后面通过1MDB丑闻来举个挪用公款的例子。

sentences.en: In that scandal, the 1MDB scandal, money that was supposed to be managed by a Malaysian government investment fund was instead spent on things like luxury real estate and a superyacht.
sentences.zh: 在那起丑闻中，本应由马来西亚政府投资基金管理的一笔资金，却被用来购买豪华房地产和超级游艇等东西。

sentences.en: Then there is nepotism. Nepotism means giving jobs or other opportunities to family members because of your personal relationship with them, rather than because they are the best person for the job.
sentences.zh: 然后是裙带关系。裙带关系意味着把工作或其他机会给到家庭成员，仅仅因为你和他们有私人关系，而不是因为他们是该岗位的最佳人选。

sentences.en: This often happens with politicians and also in businesses when people give their children or their siblings jobs just because they are family.
sentences.zh: 这种情况经常发生在政客身上，在企业里也时有发生，人们仅仅因为对方是亲戚就给自己的孩子或兄弟姐妹安排工作。

sentences.en: A related idea to nepotism is cronyism. Cronyism is when someone gives jobs or opportunities to their friends or their political allies, their cronies.
sentences.zh: 与裙带关系相关的一个概念是任人唯亲。任人唯亲是指某人把工作或机会给到朋友或政治盟友，也就是他们的亲信。

sentences.en: So nepotism is for family members. Cronyism is for friends or people not related to you.
sentences.zh: 所以裙带关系针对的是家庭成员。任人唯亲针对的是朋友或与你没有血缘关系的人。

sentences.en: Both of these can be forms of corruption.
sentences.zh: 这两种都可以是腐败的形式。

sentences.en: We can also talk about conflicts of interest.
sentences.zh: 我们还可以谈谈利益冲突。

sentences.en: A conflict of interest happens when someone’s personal interests interfere with their professional job, their professional responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 利益冲突发生在某人的个人利益与其职业工作、职业责任产生冲突的时候。

sentences.en: Interests can mean things like investments business ownings or things that they are connected to.
sentences.zh: 利益可以指投资、企业所有权或他们与之相关联的事物等。

sentences.en: I can give you an example from the UK. During the COVID-19 pandemic in the UK, a senior politician called Michelle Mone, recommended a company called PPE Medpro to the UK government.
sentences.zh: 我可以给你举一个来自英国的例子。在英国的COVID-19大流行期间，一位名叫米歇尔·莫恩的高级政客向英国政府推荐了一家名为PPE Medpro的公司。

sentences.en: This company was chosen to provide protective equipment, PPE, and received two government contracts from the Conservative government worth about £203 million pounds.
sentences.zh: 这家公司被选中提供防护装备（PPE），并从保守党政府获得了两份价值约2.03亿英镑的政府合同。

sentences.en: Michelle Mone and her husband were later found to have had financial connections to PPE Medpro.
sentences.zh: 后来人们发现，米歇尔·莫恩和她的丈夫与PPE Medpro存在财务联系。

sentences.en: She had recommended a company that her husband was invested in to the UK government.
sentences.zh: 她向英国政府推荐了一家她丈夫投资的公司。

sentences.en: The government supposedly didn’t know about her interests.
sentences.zh: 政府据称并不知道她的利益关联。

sentences.en: They trusted her recommendation and gave the contracts out.
sentences.zh: 他们信任她的推荐并将合同交了出去。

sentences.en: The best company probably didn’t get the contracts, but the one that Michelle Mone recommended did.
sentences.zh: 最好的公司可能并没有拿到合同，但米歇尔·莫恩推荐的那家拿到了。

sentences.en: Another form of corruption is called influence peddling.
sentences.zh: 另一种形式的腐败被称为影响力贩卖。

sentences.en: Peddling is a word meaning to sell something by traveling from place to place.
sentences.zh: Peddling是一个动词，意指通过四处奔走来兜售某物。

sentences.en: You peddle your wares, you peddle things.
sentences.zh: 你贩卖你的货物，你兜售东西。

sentences.en: It means to sell things. In this case, “influence peddling” is when people are selling their influence and connections.
sentences.zh: 它的意思是卖东西。在这种情况下，“影响力贩卖”是指人们在出售他们的影响力和人脉关系。

sentences.en: It’s a little bit like bribery, I guess, but instead of money, you’re selling your influence.
sentences.zh: 我想这有点像行贿，但你卖的不是金钱，而是你的影响力。

sentences.en: People use their connections or their influence to get an advantage.
sentences.zh: 人们利用自己的人脉或影响力来获取优势。

sentences.en: A powerful business person, for example, might use their relationship with a politician to influence a government decision.
sentences.zh: 例如，一个有权势的商人可能会利用自己与政客的关系来影响政府的决策。

sentences.en: They use their friendships, their relationships, their connections to have real influence.
sentences.zh: 他们利用自己的友谊、关系网、人脉来施加实质性的影响。

sentences.en: Corruption can sometimes involve fraud or manipulation as well.
sentences.zh: 腐败有时也可能涉及欺诈或操纵。

sentences.en: Companies or financial institutions might lie and commit crimes, might commit fraud, in order to gain an advantage.
sentences.zh: 公司或金融机构可能会撒谎并实施犯罪，实施欺诈，以此来获得优势。

sentences.en: The most common feature among all of the forms of corruption I’ve just mentioned is that someone is using a position of power or influence to improperly gain an advantage.
sentences.zh: 我刚才提到的所有腐败形式，它们最共同的特征是：某人利用权力和影响力来不正当地获取优势。

sentences.en: Corruption can sound quite abstract when we’re talking about definitions and systems, so I think it would be useful to introduce a few examples of corruption: the 1MDB scandal in Malaysia, the Siemens bribery scandal, and the FIFA corruption scandal.
sentences.zh: 当我们讨论定义和体制时，腐败听起来可能相当抽象，所以我觉得引入几个腐败的例子会很有用：马来西亚的1MDB丑闻、西门子行贿丑闻，以及国际足联腐败丑闻。

sentences.en: Let’s start with 1MDB or 1Malaysia Development Berhad.
sentences.zh: 让我们从1MDB或一马发展公司开始说起。

sentences.en: 1MDB was a Malaysian government investment fund.
sentences.zh: 1MDB是一个马来西亚政府投资基金。

sentences.en: It was created to raise money and invest in projects that would help Malaysia’s economic development and growth.
sentences.zh: 它设立的初衷是筹集资金并投资于有助于马来西亚经济发展和增长的项目。

sentences.en: But between 2009 and 2015, over $4.5 billion was embezzled from the fund, taken from the fund, through a complicated network of transactions and companies.
sentences.zh: 但在2009年至2015年间，超过45亿美元从该基金被挪用，通过复杂的交易网络和公司被抽走。

sentences.en: Some of this money ended up being used to purchase luxury properties in New York and London, paintings by Monet and Picasso, and a $250 million superyacht.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分资金最终被用来购买纽约和伦敦的豪宅、莫奈和毕加索的画作，以及一艘价值2.5亿美元的超级游艇。

sentences.en: In fact, $100 million of the embezzled money was used to help finance Hollywood movies, including The Wolf of Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 事实上，被挪用资金中有1亿美元被用来资助好莱坞电影，包括《华尔街之狼》。

sentences.en: The scandal involved Malaysian politicians, businessmen, financial institutions like JP Morgan.
sentences.zh: 这起丑闻涉及马来西亚政客、商人以及摩根大通等金融机构。

sentences.en: The Prime Minister, Najib Razak, was directly implicated after roughly $700 million was traced to his personal bank accounts.
sentences.zh: 时任总理纳吉布·拉扎克在约7亿美元被追查到其个人银行账户后，直接被牵连其中。

sentences.en: I think he’s still in prison right now. The second example I’ll talk about is the Siemens bribery scandal.
sentences.zh: 我想他现在应该还在监狱里。我要谈的第二个例子是西门子行贿丑闻。

sentences.en: Siemens is a huge German multinational company that operates around the world.
sentences.zh: 西门子是一家在全球运营的庞大德国跨国公司。

sentences.en: In the 2000s, it was revealed, or investigators discovered, that Siemens used secret payments and bribes to help win contracts in different countries.
sentences.zh: 在21世纪头十年，人们揭露或调查人员发现，西门子利用秘密付款和贿赂来帮助自己在不同国家赢得合同。

sentences.en: Investigators identified over $1.4 billion in bribes paid by Siemens between 2001 and 2007.
sentences.zh: 调查人员查明，在2001年至2007年间，西门子支付了超过14亿美元的贿赂。

sentences.en: These bribes were paid so that Siemens would then be given contracts for infrastructure projects.
sentences.zh: 支付这些贿赂是为了让西门子能够获得基础设施建设项目的合同。

sentences.en: The bribes resulted in Siemens getting contracts for telecommunications networks in Nigeria, power grids in Israel, transit systems in Venezuela, and medical equipment in Russia.
sentences.zh: 这些贿赂让西门子拿到了尼日利亚电信网络、以色列电网、委内瑞拉交通系统以及俄罗斯医疗设备的合同。

sentences.en: The company had systems for making these payments and also hiding these payments, because they knew what they were doing was wrong.
sentences.zh: 这家公司有一套进行这些付款并将其隐藏的系统，因为他们知道自己在做坏事。

sentences.en: In December 2008, Siemens agreed to pay roughly $1.6 billion in fines and penalties, about £800 million to the US government and a similar amount to the German government.
sentences.zh: 在2008年12月，西门子同意支付约16亿美元的罚款和处罚，其中向美国政府支付了约8亿英镑，向德国政府支付了相当数额的罚款。

sentences.en: And we should also talk about FIFA, the international organization that governs football.
sentences.zh: 我们还应该谈谈国际足联（FIFA），这个管理足球运动的国际组织。

sentences.en: In 2015, US and Swiss authorities launched a major investigation into FIFA and into FIFA officials.
sentences.zh: 2015年，美国和瑞士当局对国际足联及国际足联官员展开了一场重大调查。

sentences.en: Several of FIFA’s main officials were accused of accepting bribes and kickbacks connected to things such as television rights, sponsorship deals, and major football tournaments.
sentences.zh: 国际足联几位主要官员被指控接受与电视转播权、赞助协议以及大型足球赛事等相关的贿赂和回扣。

sentences.en: Kickbacks is when you award someone a contract and you get a bit of the money back as a thank you payment.
sentences.zh: 回扣是指你把合同判给某人，然后作为感谢费，对方把部分钱退还给你。

sentences.en: A kickback is a bit like a bribe, but it’s paid after you make your decision, not before you make your decision.
sentences.zh: 回扣有点像贿赂，但它是在你做出决定之后支付的，而不是在决定之前支付的。

sentences.en: Executives from FIFA and also its regional federations, most notably CONCACAF, which is the North Central American Football Association, and CONMEBOL, which is the South American Football Association, accepted over $200 million in bribes and kickbacks from sports marketing firms.
sentences.zh: 来自国际足联及其地区联合会的高管们——其中最著名的是中北美及加勒比海足球协会（CONCACAF）和南美洲足球协会（CONMEBOL）——从体育营销公司那里接受了超过2亿美元的贿赂和回扣。

sentences.en: They would take money in exchange for the commercial rights to major tournaments, the ability to show those tournaments on TV or to use the video footage or to use the name of the tournaments.
sentences.zh: 他们收受金钱以换取大型赛事的商业权利，即在电视上转播这些赛事、使用视频素材或使用赛事名称的权力。

sentences.en: Investigations also revealed corruption in the selection process for the 2018 and the 2022 World Cups.
sentences.zh: 调查还揭露了2018年和2022年世界杯举办地选择过程中的腐败行为。

sentences.en: Those World Cups ultimately went to Russia and Qatar.
sentences.zh: 这两届世界杯最终分别落户俄罗斯和卡塔尔。

sentences.en: Furthermore, longtime FIFA president Sepp Blatter and also UEFA president Michel Platini were kicked out of FIFA and UEFA and banned from football after it was discovered that they were sending multi-million dollar amounts of money between themselves.
sentences.zh: 此外，长期的国际足联主席布拉特以及欧足联主席普拉蒂尼在被发现他们之间有数百万美元的资金往来后，也被开除出国际足联和欧足联，并被禁止参与足球活动。

sentences.en: Again, what connects these three scandals, in Malaysia, in Germany, and internationally with FIFA, is that it’s people in positions of power abusing their power, abusing their positions.
sentences.zh: 再次说明，连接这三起丑闻（发生在马来西亚、德国以及国际足联这一国际组织中）的共同点是：身居高位的人在滥用他们的权力、滥用他们的职位。

sentences.en: But why? Why does corruption exist? Corruption usually appears when people have lots of power and they have the opportunity to abuse that power.
sentences.zh: 但为什么呢？为什么会存在腐败？腐败通常出现在人们拥有巨大权力且有机会滥用这些权力的时候。

sentences.en: It also occurs in places where the systems that are supposed to stop corruption are weak.
sentences.zh: 它也发生在那些本应用来阻止腐败的体制十分薄弱的地方。

sentences.en: One important factor is a lack of transparency.
sentences.zh: 一个重要的因素是缺乏透明度。

sentences.en: In other words, it is easier to hide corrupt behavior when decisions and deals happen behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，当决策和交易在闭门造车中进行时，隐藏腐败行为就更容易了。

sentences.en: Behind closed doors means happening in private or in secret.
sentences.zh: 闭门造车意味着在私下或秘密中发生。

sentences.en: Making business deals or political decisions completely in private, completely secretly, with no public knowledge, means that most people will never know who makes the decision or why those decisions were made.
sentences.zh: 完全在私下里、完全秘密地进行商业交易或政治决策，没有公众知情，这意味着大多数人永远不会知道是谁做出了决定，或者为什么要做这些决定。

sentences.en: Another factor is weak institutions. Institutions are organizations and systems in a country.
sentences.zh: 另一个因素是体制薄弱。体制是一个国家中的组织和系统。

sentences.en: For example, banks are financial institutions, the military is a government institution, schools are educational institutions, and things like marriage are social institutions.
sentences.zh: 例如，银行是金融机构，军队是政府机构，学校是教育机构，而像婚姻这样的事物则是社会机构。

sentences.en: Institutions like independent courts, regulators police forces, journalists, and organizations that investigate wrongdoing, like watchdogs, are really important to help prevent corruption.
sentences.zh: 诸如独立的法院、监管机构、警察力量、记者，以及调查不法行为的组织（如监督机构）等体制，对于帮助防止腐败至关重要。

sentences.en: Journalists can investigate and report corruption in the media.
sentences.zh: 记者可以在媒体上调查并曝光腐败。

sentences.en: The police can prosecute crimes. Regulators or watchdogs can launch investigations.
sentences.zh: 警方可以起诉犯罪。监管机构或监督机构可以展开调查。

sentences.en: But if these institutions are weak or nonexistent, if the journalists are not free to report the news, or if the police are also corrupt, and if there’s no regulator in a country, it kind of means that corrupt individuals can act without any consequences.
sentences.zh: 但如果这些机构很弱或者根本不存在，如果记者不能自由报道新闻，或者警察也同流合污，而且一个国家里没有监管机构，这基本上意味着腐败分子可以为所欲为而不承担任何后果。

sentences.en: It’s hard to find corruption when you’re not looking for it.
sentences.zh: 当你根本没有去寻找腐败时，你是很难发现它的。

sentences.en: Another important factor is a lack of accountability.
sentences.zh: 另一个重要因素是缺乏问责制。

sentences.en: Accountability means being responsible for your actions.
sentences.zh: 问责意味着对自己的行为负责。

sentences.en: People are much more likely to abuse their power if they know they will not be punished for it, right?
sentences.zh: 如果人们知道自己不会因此受到惩罚，他们就更有可能滥用权力，对吧？

sentences.en: If you know you’re probably not going to be caught because there is weak institutions, and even if you were caught, you’re not going to be punished because there’s a lack of accountability, it makes it a bit easier to be corrupt, I guess.
sentences.zh: 如果你知道自己大概率不会被抓，因为体制很弱；而且即便被抓了也不会受到惩罚，因为缺乏问责制，我想这就让人更容易去搞腐败了。

sentences.en: Government officials have the power to decide which company receives a contract worth millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 政府官员有权决定哪家公司能拿到价值数百万美元的合同。

sentences.en: It’s a lot of power, a lot of money they can use.
sentences.zh: 这是巨大的权力，有大量的金钱可供他们支配。

sentences.en: And without strong rules governing the process or people overseeing the process, and the decision needing to be publicly justified, the official has the opportunity to do what they want.
sentences.zh: 如果没有约束这个过程的强力规则，没有监督这个过程的人，且决策不需要向公众说明正当理由，官员就会有机会为所欲为。

sentences.en: Maybe they just give the contract to build a new bridge to their friend, or they give the contract to build a new hospital to their political donor, the person who gave them money during their campaign.
sentences.zh: 也许他们只是把建造新桥的合同给了他们的朋友，或者把建新医院的合同给了他们的政治金主——也就是在竞选期间给他们钱的人。

sentences.en: Culture and expectations can also matter.
sentences.zh: 文化和预期同样重要。

sentences.en: There are parts of the world today where bribery and nepotism and favoritism are normal.
sentences.zh: 当今世界的某些地方，行贿、裙带关系和偏袒是司空见惯的。

sentences.en: I found some statistics online from Transparency International.
sentences.zh: 我在网上找到了一些来自“透明国际”的统计数据。

sentences.en: Admittedly, they’re a bit out of date now, they’re from 2013.
sentences.zh: 不可否认，这些数据现在有点过时了，它们来自2013年。

sentences.en: But they reported that 84% of people in Sierra Leone had paid someone a bribe in their lifetime.
sentences.zh: 但他们报告说，塞拉利昂84%的人在一生中都向别人行过贿。

sentences.en: It’s become expected. You need to pay bribes to get things done in your personal life.
sentences.zh: 这已经成了理所当然的事。你在个人生活中必须通过行贿才能把事情办成。

sentences.en: You might need to pay bribes to the police, or pay bribes while you’re driving on the road, or pay bribes to get government documents.
sentences.zh: 你可能需要向警察行贿，或者在开车上路时行贿，又或是为了拿到政府文件而行贿。

sentences.en: It’s not just Sierra Leone either. There were lots of countries where over 50% of people had paid bribes in their lifetime.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是塞拉利昂。有许多国家的半数以上人口在一生中都行过贿。

sentences.en: In places like that, where corruption is common, corruption can become self-reinforcing.
sentences.zh: 在那种腐败普遍存在的地方，腐败会变成一种自我强化的循环。

sentences.en: Everyone is corrupt because everyone expects everyone else to be corrupt.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在腐败，因为每个人都期望别人也腐败。

sentences.en: In a place like Sierra Leone where corruption is widespread, what happens?
sentences.zh: 在像塞拉利昂这样腐败蔓延的地方，会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: What are the consequences of corruption?
sentences.zh: 腐败会带来什么后果？

sentences.en: The most obvious consequence is that money is lost.
sentences.zh: 最显而易见的后果就是金钱的流失。

sentences.en: Enormous amounts of money can go missing through embezzlement or other corrupt practices.
sentences.zh: 巨额资金会通过挪用公款或其他腐败行径凭空消失。

sentences.en: Corruption can damage economic growth as well.
sentences.zh: 腐败也会破坏经济增长。

sentences.en: Countries need to build things like roads or bridges or hospitals.
sentences.zh: 国家需要建设道路、桥梁或医院等设施。

sentences.en: In corrupt places, the government might choose a company that has paid a bribe to build the infrastructure instead of choosing the best company.
sentences.zh: 在腐败盛行的地方，政府可能会选择一家通过行贿获得合同的公司来建设基础设施，而不是选择最好的公司。

sentences.en: This means that the project might become more expensive.
sentences.zh: 这意味着项目可能会变得更加昂贵。

sentences.en: It’ll probably take longer or produce a lower quality building.
sentences.zh: 它大概率会耗时更长，或者建造出质量更差的建筑。

sentences.en: I think Venezuela is an example of this.
sentences.zh: 我想委内瑞拉就是一个例子。

sentences.en: They have massive reserves of oil, but they’re not particularly efficient at extracting that oil.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有庞大的石油储备，但在开采这些石油方面并不是特别高效。

sentences.en: There are many reasons for this. Lack of investment is one, and institutional problems, but corruption is an issue as well.
sentences.zh: 这背后的原因有很多。缺乏投资是一个原因，体制问题也是，但腐败同样是个大问题。

sentences.en: In the past, the government gave maintenance contracts to their political allies, people who paid them bribes.
sentences.zh: 过去，政府把维护合同给了他们的政治盟友，也就是给他们行贿的人。

sentences.en: And this meant that Venezuela’s oil fields and the infrastructure was not maintained well because the contract was given to the wrong company.
sentences.zh: 这意味着委内瑞拉的油田和基础设施没有得到良好的维护，因为合同被交给了错误的公司。

sentences.en: And so sometimes it can really affect your economic development.
sentences.zh: 所以有时候它真的会影响你的经济发展。

sentences.en: Businesses are also less likely to invest somewhere if they believe they need to pay a bribe.
sentences.zh: 如果企业认为自己需要行贿，它们也就不太愿意去某个地方投资。

sentences.en: Money intended for public services can disappear in corrupt countries.
sentences.zh: 本应用於公共服务的资金可能会在腐败的国家里不翼而飞。

sentences.en: And corruption can make it harder for normal people to access services.
sentences.zh: 而且腐败会使普通人更难获得各项服务。

sentences.en: In some places, people may be expected to pay bribes to receive services that should be free.
sentences.zh: 在某些地方，人们可能需要付费行贿才能获得本应免费的服务。

sentences.en: Corruption destroys trust, basically. Corruption is a trust destroyer.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，腐败摧毁了信任。腐败是信任的终结者。

sentences.en: Corruption could mean that the government is stealing from you, or that it is impossible for a small business to succeed without paying bribes, or that the police will just ignore crimes committed by some people because they’re corrupt as well.
sentences.zh: 腐败可能意味着政府在偷你的钱，或者小企业不付贿赂就根本无法成功，亦或是警察对某些人犯下的罪行视而不见，因为他们自己也同流合污了。

sentences.en: Once you believe that everything is corrupt, once your trust disappears, corruption is harder to fight.
sentences.zh: 一旦你相信一切都是腐败的，一旦你的信任荡然无存，腐败就更难与之抗衡了。

sentences.en: It creates a cycle. Corruption produces distrust.
sentences.zh: 这就形成了一个循环。腐败产生不信任。

sentences.en: Distrust weakens institutions. Weak institutions make corruption easier.
sentences.zh: 不信任削弱了体制。脆弱的体制让腐败变得更容易。

sentences.en: People just get used to corruption. Modern corruption often crosses borders as well.
sentences.zh: 人们对腐败习以为常。现代腐败往往也跨越了国界。

sentences.en: It’s not just stuck in one country. Stolen money can be moved through foreign bank accounts and into foreign property markets.
sentences.zh: 它不仅仅局限于一个国内。被偷走的钱可以通过海外银行账户转移到海外房地产市场中。

sentences.en: Sani Abacha was the military dictator of Nigeria from 1993 to 1998.
sentences.zh: 萨尼·阿巴查是尼日利亚从1993年到1998年的军事独裁者。

sentences.en: He is considered perhaps the most corrupt person ever, definitely one of the most corrupt leaders of the entire 20th century.
sentences.zh: 他被认为是史上最腐败的人之一，绝对是整个20世纪最腐败的领导人之一。

sentences.en: The way he did it was simple, I guess. His friend was the national security advisor of Nigeria.
sentences.zh: 我想他作案的方式很简单。他的朋友是尼日利亚的国家安全顾问。

sentences.en: The national security advisor would request funding from the government for a security emergency.
sentences.zh: 国家安全顾问会以应对安全紧急情况为由向政府申请资金。

sentences.en: The president would then approve that funding, and the government would send cash or a check to the national security advisor.
sentences.zh: 然后总统批准这笔资金，政府会向国家安全顾问发送现金或支票。

sentences.en: The advisor would then take the cash, that was supposed to be for national security, and deliver it to President Abacha’s house.
sentences.zh: 接着顾问会把这笔本应用于国家安全的现金拿走，送到阿巴查总统的家里。

sentences.en: Money would then be moved overseas. Most of Abacha’s stolen money ended up in Swiss bank accounts and also in the UK and US financial systems.
sentences.zh: 然后资金被转移到海外。阿巴查偷走的钱大多最终流向了瑞士银行账户，以及英国和美国的金融系统。

sentences.en: But it wasn’t just a small amount of money. $5 billion worth of government money, that could’ve been spent helping the Nigerian economy to develop, providing social benefits to the people of Nigeria.
sentences.zh: 但这绝不是一笔小数目。价值5亿美元的政府资金，本可以用来帮助尼日利亚经济发展，为尼日利亚人民提供社会福利。

sentences.en: Instead, it was used to buy property in New York and London and sit in Swiss bank accounts.
sentences.zh: 相反，它们被用来在纽约和伦敦买房，并静静躺在瑞士的银行账户里。

sentences.en: So how can we fight corruption? Is it possible to end corruption?
sentences.zh: 那么我们该如何打击腐败？腐败有可能被彻底消除吗？

sentences.en: There needs to be more transparency. Governments and organizations need to make information about the decisions they’re making, or the spending they’re committing to, available to the public.
sentences.zh: 我们需要更多的透明度。政府和组织需要向公众公开他们正在做出的决策或正在投入资金的信息。

sentences.en: If you can see where money is going and who is benefiting from the money, it becomes quite hard to hide corruption.
sentences.zh: 如果你能看到钱流向了哪里以及谁从这笔钱中受益，隐藏腐败就会变得相当困难。

sentences.en: There also needs to be accountability. There must be strong institutions capable of investigating and punishing corruption.
sentences.zh: 同样需要的是问责制。必须有能够调查和惩罚腐败的强力体制。

sentences.en: This is why strong and independent courts and police forces and journalists and auditors, regulators, anti-corruption organizations are needed.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们需要强大且独立的法院、警察力量、记者、审计师、监管机构以及反腐组织。

sentences.en: They need to be able to investigate powerful people without being controlled or threatened by them.
sentences.zh: 他们必须能够在不受权贵控制或威胁的情况下调查有权有势的人。

sentences.en: Whistleblowers are similarly important. A whistleblower is a person who reports illegal or unethical behavior.
sentences.zh: 吹哨人同样重要。吹哨人是指举报非法或不道德行为的人。

sentences.en: They need to be protected as well. We also need clear rules about conflicts of interest.
sentences.zh: 他们也需要受到保护。我们还需要制定关于利益冲突的明确规则。

sentences.en: People in positions of power should not be able to make decisions that directly benefit themselves or their families.
sentences.zh: 身居高位的人不应该被允许做出直接让自己或家人受益的决策。

sentences.en: Donald Trump, for example, the current president of the USA recently, relatively recently, launched a cryptocurrency that made him millions of dollars while he was about to become president.
sentences.zh: 例如，美国现任总统唐纳德·特朗普最近（相对最近）推出了一种加密货币，在他即将成为总统之际为他赚了数百万美元。

sentences.en: And I think his wife also launched a cryptocurrency as well.
sentences.zh: 我想他的妻子也推出了加密货币。

sentences.en: That’s a conflict of interest. Should a president be able to launch a cryptocurrency that makes them lots of money personally?
sentences.zh: 这就是利益冲突。总统难道应该被允许推出能让他们个人赚大钱的加密货币吗？

sentences.en: There needs to be meaningful penalties and punishments for corruption.
sentences.zh: 必须对腐败实行有意义的处罚和惩罚措施。

sentences.en: Corruption is quite profitable. Being corrupt can make you a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 腐败的利润非常丰厚。腐败可以让你赚到大钱。

sentences.en: When the chance of being caught is really small, and if you are caught you’re not punished very severely, it makes corruption seem quite a good option.
sentences.zh: 当被抓的几率真的很小，而且即便被抓了也没有受到严厉惩罚时，这会让腐败看起来是个相当不错的选项。

sentences.en: You’re probably not going to be caught, and even if you are caught, you won’t go to prison.
sentences.zh: 你大概率不会被抓，即便被抓了也不会进监狱。

sentences.en: I think harsher punishments and increasing the chances of someone being caught by having stronger institutions can make corruption less profitable and less common.
sentences.zh: 我认为，通过拥有更强大的体制来加大惩罚力度并提高被抓的概率，可以使腐败变得不那么有利可图，也更加少见。

sentences.en: There is also an important international dimension.
sentences.zh: 这里还有一个重要的国际维度。

sentences.en: As with cases like the 1MDB scandal or FIFA, corrupt money can move across borders quickly.
sentences.zh: 正如1MDB丑闻或国际足联案那样，腐败资金可以迅速跨越国界。

sentences.en: Fighting corruption requires countries to work together and share information.
sentences.zh: 打击腐败需要各国携手合作并共享信息。

sentences.en: In some places, the biggest challenge is changing the culture around corruption.
sentences.zh: 在某些地方，最大的挑战是改变围绕腐败的文化。

sentences.en: When corruption is expected, when corruption is normal, it makes it really hard to end corruption.
sentences.zh: 当腐败成为常态，当腐败习以为常时，要终结腐败就变得难上加难了。

sentences.en: Corruption is the abuse of power or influence for personal or improper gain, and it can happen in governments, businesses, and organizations around the world.
sentences.zh: 腐败是为个人或不正当利益而滥用权力和影响力，它可能发生在世界各地的政府、企业和组织之中。

sentences.en: In this episode, we’ve seen how corruption can take many forms, why it happens, and how it damages economies, democracies, public services, people’s trust.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们看到了腐败如何以多种形式存在、它为什么会发生，以及它是如何破坏经济、民主、公共服务和人们的信任的。

sentences.en: It kind of damages everything. I gave examples including the 1MDB scandal, Siemens bribery scandal, and FIFA corruption.
sentences.zh: 它几乎破坏了一切。我举的例子包括1MDB丑闻、西门子行贿丑闻和国际足联腐败案。

sentences.en: These examples show that corruption can be complex and international.
sentences.zh: 这些例子表明，腐败可以错综复杂且具有国际性。

sentences.en: In the end, I think fighting corruption requires transparency, accountability, strong institutions, and meaningful consequences.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，我认为打击腐败需要透明度、问责制、强有力的体制和切实有力的后果。

sentences.en: But what do you think? How is corruption in your country?
sentences.zh: 但你怎么看？你国家的腐败情况怎么样？

sentences.en: Are there any famous corruption scandals in your country that you could tell us about?
sentences.zh: 你们国家有什么著名的腐败丑闻可以跟我们讲讲吗？

sentences.en: Have you ever had to pay a bribe for something?
sentences.zh: 你曾经被迫为某事行过贿吗？
